steps.title: Setup Project Structure
steps.description: Initializes the Android project with essential files like manifest and build.gradle for basic configuration.

steps.title: Define Backend API Schema
steps.description: Creates the api_schema.json file, outlining the backend collections, fields, and operations required for student data management and user authentication.

steps.title: Implement Utility for Shared Preferences
steps.description: Develops a utility class to manage storage and retrieval of user authentication tokens using Android's SharedPreferences.

steps.title: Create Backend API Client
steps.description: Develops a client class (BackendApi) to handle all HTTP requests to the TrumpleDroid generic backend API. This includes reading the app_id from assets/app-meta.json at runtime, and using the correct /login, /register, and /data endpoints for authentication and CRUD operations, addressing the 404 errors.

steps.title: Design Login Activity UI
steps.description: Creates the XML layout for the user login screen, including input fields for email and password, and a login button.

steps.title: Implement Login Activity Logic
steps.description: Codes the Java logic for LoginActivity to handle user input, correctly instantiate BackendApi with Context, interact with the BackendApi for authentication, store the token, and navigate to the main activity. Improved error handling to display messages from the backend.

steps.title: Design Registration Activity UI
steps.description: Creates the XML layout for the user registration screen, including input fields for email and password, and a register button.

steps.title: Implement Registration Activity Logic
steps.description: Codes the Java logic for RegisterActivity to handle user input, correctly instantiate BackendApi with Context, interact with the BackendApi for new user registration, store the token, and navigate to the main activity. Improved error handling to display messages from the backend.

steps.title: Define Student Data Model
steps.description: Creates a Java class (Student) to represent the data structure for a student record, including name, phone, class, and roll number.

steps.title: Design Student List Item Layout
steps.description: Creates the XML layout for individual student items displayed in the ListView of the main activity.

steps.title: Design Main Activity UI (Student List)
steps.description: Creates the XML layout for the main activity, featuring a ListView to display student records and a button to add new students.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity Logic
steps.description: Codes the Java logic for MainActivity to correctly instantiate BackendApi with Context, fetch and display student records, handle adding new students, and navigate to the student detail screen for editing/viewing.

steps.title: Design Student Detail Activity UI
steps.description: Creates the XML layout for the activity used to add, view, or edit a single student record, including input fields and save/delete buttons.

steps.title: Implement Student Detail Activity Logic
steps.description: Codes the Java logic for StudentDetailActivity to correctly instantiate BackendApi with Context, handle input for student details, perform create, update, or delete operations via the BackendApi, and navigate back.

steps.title: Building Student Management
steps.description: Compiles and packages the Student Management app into an installable APK.
